_comment: A 2.5-minute mcp.senzing.com CONNECT_TIMEOUT window made 11 of 36 runs start with no Senzing tools in session. The skills behaved correctly -- poc-planner refuses to write a plan it cannot ground -- but the gate scored those sessions anyway and reported 40 plugin assertion failures for an outage it had already detected. Run 0 here is blind: its deterministic graders 'fail' because the tools were absent. Run 1 is connected and clean. gate.py must EXCLUDE run 0 from the plugin verdict, grade the case on run 1, and still exit 2 structurally so the run stays red and unmergeable -- never 0.
